parameters.query: SELECT nucleo.correio_oauth_pegar($1, $2) AS o, $3 AS code, $4 AS erro_provedor
SELECT CASE WHEN $2 = 'sim' THEN nucleo.correio_oauth_salvar($1, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::jsonb) END AS conta_id

parameters.redirectURL: ={{ (() => { const t = $('Trocar codigo').first().json; const v = t.volta || $env.PAINEL_URL || 'https://iacentralleo.vercel.app/'; const s = v.includes('?') ? '&' : '?'; return t.ok ? v + s + 'correio=ok&conta=' + encodeURIComponent(t.email) : v + s + 'correio_erro=' + encodeURIComponent(t.erro); })() }}
